notes: When Dueling against Yuka Goha at Level 40 or higher, these are the only cards that can drop; at lower levels, cards from the standard pool for Legendary Duelists may also drop.
The Yuga Ohdo spawned by the event possess the same rewards, but since they only spawn at Level 30, cards from the standard pool may also drop.

rows.text: "Player #C39: Home Run Smasher", "Player #99: Grand Slam Dragon"

notes: The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remains open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, Gold, and Skill Chips. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.
These missions were available from the start of the event.
